title: August and the Terminal
author: August Thackeray
blurb: Freya Sterling, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
